newsitem.title: DENMARK: HSBC MARKETS SAY SELL SWEDISH BONDS, BUY DANISH.
newsitem.headline: HSBC MARKETS SAY SELL SWEDISH BONDS, BUY DANISH.

text.p: HSBC Markets recommends investors to sell Swedish bonds and buy Danish in its latest Global Markets Weekly received by Reuters on Monday.
"The 10-year spread between Sweden and Denmark has narrowed substantially and is now back to historic lows, at close to 25 basis points," HSBC analysts said.
"Arguably this spread has now moved into expensive territory and indeed, looking ahead on the news front, Sweden is unlikely to get the upper hand," they wrote.
They foresaw that a more hostile environmemt in the international bond market stemming from renewed strength in the U.S. economy would hurt the Swedish bond market more than its Danish counterpart.

Swedish domestic political events, notably the supplementary budget to be unveiled in September, pressure on the ruling Social Democrats to increase public spending and general elections due in 1998, were cited as stirring nervousness in the markets.
